kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
انبلعت (form VII)
# اِنْبَلَعْتُ (inbalaʕtu) /in.ba.laʕ.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِنْبَلَعَ (inbalaʕa)
# اِنْبَلَعْتَ (inbalaʕta) /in.ba.laʕ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِنْبَلَعَ (inbalaʕa)
# اِنْبَلَعْتِ (inbalaʕti) /in.ba.laʕ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِنْبَلَعَ (inbalaʕa)
# اِنْبَلَعَتْ (inbalaʕat) /in.ba.la.ʕat/: third-person
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
